ideas.name: Peer-conditional conformal prediction (PCCP) for multi-agent LLM decisions
ideas.problem: Clean-calibrated conformal coverage collapses 90%->74% under unanimous-wrong peers; weighted CP reduces to identity; condition-aware recalibration needs pressure labels (Hu & Su, arXiv 2609.04445, 2026-09-03). Defense left open.
ideas.method: Solo-anchored split conformal (calibrate on no-peer scores; exchangeability intact) + act-gate (act on a singleton only if the social answer lies in the solo set) + online pressure detector from solo/social score divergence; Mondrian variant conditioned on observable peer statistics with augmented synthetic-peer calibration.
ideas.theory: Coverage of the solo set is the standard split-conformal guarantee for any peer-message distribution; false-action rate <= alpha; bin-conditional coverage for the Mondrian variant.
ideas.experiments: Reproduce 2609.04445 with released code (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Gemma-2-9B; ARC-C, TruthfulQA); baselines clean CP, per-model Mondrian, condition-aware recalibration (oracle), Conformal Social Choice (2604.07667).
ideas.gate: Under unanimous-wrong peers at alpha=0.10: act-on-wrong <= 10% and coverage >= 90% with abstention strictly below condition-aware recalibration; otherwise the method is trivial.
ideas.occupiedBy: none for the repair; problem owned by 2609.04445 / 2604.07667 / 2606.00820
ideas.infraReuse: medium (conformal + null-control code; Mistral/Qwen3 on disk)
ideas.risk: high scoop risk (paper is days old; simple idea) -> speed

ideas.name: Black-box, trace-only collusion detection with exact FPR control
ideas.problem: Only strong detector is white-box (activation probes, 0.73-0.93 AUROC zero-shot on NARCBench, arXiv 2604.01151); black-box proposal (arXiv 2608.02698) has placeholder results; cross-principal monitors cannot read activations.
ideas.method: Pairwise residual dependence between agents' messages beyond the shared context (TF-IDF/stylometry, stance trajectories, timing), permutation null that reassigns agent identities across scenarios, group-level closed testing; report an empirical detection-capacity frontier.
ideas.theory: Exact FPR control from permutation tests; power vs covert bit-rate (capacity frontier).
ideas.experiments: CPU on released NARCBench transcripts (3 tiers); second testbed with our coordinated-adversary generator + covert-channel instruction (<= 2 GPU-h); baselines LLM-judge classifier, published white-box numbers.
ideas.gate: Zero-shot AUROC >= 0.75 on the hardest tier at FPR <= 0.05 by construction; < 0.60 -> stop.
ideas.infraReuse: high (permutation null, readouts, adversary generator, judge baseline)
ideas.risk: medium (Oxford group active; hardest tier may still be explicit collusion)

ideas.name: Prompt-only radioactivity: inheritance of instruction signatures under distillation
ideas.problem: Active trace-rewriting watermarks detect distilled students (arXiv 2602.15143: TPR 1.00 / FPR <= 0.02); token-level radioactivity needs decoding access; no report on whether a trigger-free prompt-only signature (ICW, echo) survives SFT.
ideas.method: TF-IDF per-key readout trained on teacher traces, applied to student outputs on held-out problems; wrong-key permutation null for FPR; instruction-family design for learnability.
ideas.theory: Two-sample test power vs number of watermarked training traces and echo strength.
ideas.experiments: LoRA-SFT Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B on 700-2000 traces per key, 4 keys x 2 students (<= 4 GPU-h).
ideas.gate: Student-output attribution >= 2x chance at permutation-null FPR <= 0.05; N2's no-key residual (1.5-1.9x) is the prior, negative likely.
ideas.occupiedBy: adjacent: 2602.15143 (active, stronger); TextSeal / Sander et al. (token-level)
ideas.risk: negative first result likely -> analysis, not method

ideas.name: Conclusion-blind fault localization with independently verified evidence
ideas.problem: Pipeline auditors relay conclusions instead of checking; hiding conclusions gives +41 pp fault-origin accuracy; remedy left open (arXiv 2609.07680, 2026-09-07). Injected relay errors persist and are localizable (2607.09678).
ideas.method: Each hop emits machine-checkable evidence; auditor sees only CPU-verified evidence multisets per hop; fault = first hop whose evidence fails re-computation or contradicts verified upstream evidence; auditor never reads conclusions or prose (injection-immune by construction).
ideas.theory: Localization within one hop under an honest checker; false-flag rate = checker false-reject on evidence diffs.
ideas.experiments: Relay chains with one corrupted hop (numeric / semantic / injected auditor note), Tulu+Qwen3 generators, Qwen3+Mistral relays (<= 3 GPU-h); baselines LLM auditor with/without conclusion field, STAR-style verifier.
ideas.gate: Localization accuracy >= LLM-auditor-without-conclusions + 10 pp under injected auditor notes.
ideas.occupiedBy: problem named by 2609.07680; failure-attribution task exists with LLM judges
ideas.infraReuse: highest (relay testbed, CPU verifier, adversary generator, baselines, SVRA data)
ideas.risk: numeric corruption too easy, semantic too hard (verifier passes 44% of honest-wrong traces)

ideas.name: Prompt-only last-writer attribution + relay-fidelity test
ideas.problem: Multi-writer attribution from final text exists only with decoding access (IET 2603.17445, Chronology RSOS 2026, TRACE 2607.08400); prompt-only is open but upstream echo dies under lossy relays (S20).
ideas.method: Attribute the last writer by its instruction echo; use presence/absence of upstream echo as a relay-fidelity statistic with a permutation null.
ideas.experiments: Relay testbed with per-hop keys, 2 relay families.
ideas.gate: Last-writer top-1 >= 3x chance after 3 hops on both relays.

ideas.name: Prompt-only computational-obligation watermark (P4 with executed obligations)
ideas.problem: ReasonMark (ICLR 2026) / SWAN are decoding-time; ICW is lexical; a paraphrase-invariant prompt-only carrier would be which quantities are computed.
ideas.method: Key selects obligations that models actually execute and a CPU can check; detector = verifier signatures.
ideas.experiments: Obligation-screening run first (which obligations are executed), then LEX vs obligation vs ICW under paraphrase + monitor-aware scrubbing.
ideas.gate: At least 3 obligations with V3-style separation >= 0.3 on two generators; else capacity < 2 bits -> stop.
ideas.risk: D1/G0 evidence against; capacity ~1 bit today
